verdict.rationale: LibreChat claims code execution runs "securely with zero setup" through its Code Interpreter API, which implies some isolated execution. It also has an Access Control feature and per-role/per-group configuration overrides that could limit what users or agents can use. However, the evidence never describes how code is isolated, and nothing shows per-tool policies or approval/permission modes for MCP tools, which can include file system and browser access. missing for 10: documented container/VM isolation details for code execution, per-tool or per-MCP-server permission policies, approval/permission modes for risky tool calls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
